events.summary: Heating oil prices have surged to record levels, with local suppliers saying they have never seen anything similar.
Trump says refinery disruptions, not Hormuz, are the main cause of rising U.S. gasoline prices.
Analysis discusses what investors shorting Boeing stock may be overlooking.
M2.81 earthquake occurred 5 km NE of Hydesville, California.
A magnitude 4.3 earthquake occurred 17 km WNW of Ashkāsham, Afghanistan.
UnitedHealth awarded a 257-unit stock grant to director Baker.
Natural gas prices stayed near the 50‑day moving average as mild weather limited demand for November deliveries.
USGS reported a magnitude 4.4 earthquake located 12 km north of Villa El Carmen, Nicaragua.
Platinum prices face new negative pressures, according to a forecast published on 5‑10‑2026.
Nvidia shares reach all‑time high, bringing market cap close to $6 trillion.
Indian singer Anuv Jain discusses selective music releases.
A forest fire started in Angola on 04/10/2026 and continued until 05/10/2026.
Magnitude 3.2 earthquake near Eagle Village, Alaska.
New York declared a measles disaster as the disease resurges across the United States due to falling vaccination rates.
Syrian Airlines unveiled a new visual identity as part of its post‑Assad rebranding.
Taiwan's 304 list prices rose again, marking third consecutive increase, per Shanghai Metals Market.
USGS reported a magnitude 2.5 earthquake 82 km SW of Kaktovik, Alaska.
Fort Hood shooter Nidal Malik Hasan to be executed by firing squad, first US military execution since 1961.
Paramount faces higher risk after Warner deal; Disney and Netflix seen as better bets.
Manchester City striker Erling Haaland was substituted during a 2-1 loss to Liverpool in Porto, raising injury concerns.
Violent clashes erupted during a housing protest in Barcelona, with fires and barricades.
FXEmpire forecasts natural gas price at $3.12, testing resistance and maintaining bullish momentum.
OpenAI admits its response to Australian government hacks was insufficient.
An ASX‑listed rare‑earth company plans to expand production, according to Morningstar Australia.
Flood in Guatemala from Oct 3-5 displaced 20 people, no deaths.
Swedish steelmaker SSAB announced it will raise plate prices by $60 per ton.
Members of Mexican and Colombian cartels filmed fighting in Ukraine, reportedly joining the International Legion to learn drone warfare.
Amnesty International reported that Moroccan authorities have surveilled journalists, based on a whistleblower account.
Gaza mother lost two husbands and two children amid Israel's war.
A 4.6 magnitude earthquake occurred in the Izu Islands region of Japan.
Boeing and other US defense AI firms saw increased stock focus after a Pentagon policy shift.
Samoan leader apologizes for Nazi salute shown in 2007 video, acknowledging offense.
A 4.9‑magnitude earthquake struck Yap in the Federated States of Micronesia.
Magnitude 3.1 earthquake near Denali Park, Alaska, on Oct 3.
Oil prices rose as traders balanced Gulf region tensions with strong Middle East export levels.
Caterpillar plans a $1B bet on North Carolina, citing an undervalued view.
Gas prices in Idaho fell despite ongoing Middle East tensions, reflecting localized market dynamics.
The Parti Quebecois won the Quebec election, pledging a third referendum on Quebec independence from Canada.
Apple Inc. shareholders would need a specific number of shares to earn $10,000 annually in dividends.
Apple CEO Tim Cook sold $63.8M in company stock.
US officials under former President Trump have pursued a record number of cases to revoke citizenship of naturalized Americans.
WBMA reported gasoline prices in Birmingham dropped almost 11 cents in a week.
Police in Kosovo clashed with protesters opposing a proposal to limit the Hague war crimes court's jurisdiction.
Former President Donald Trump said taxpayer money will no longer fund TV ads praising him.
USGS reported a magnitude 3.4 earthquake 4 km NE of Big Lake, Alaska.
Former ‘American Idol’ contestant Caleb Flynn was sentenced to life without parole for murdering his wife.
The US removed B-1 bombers from RAF Fairford in England after a perceived threat.
Turkey and Pakistan agreed in Riyadh to send rapid deployment forces to Saudi Arabia as fighting in Yemen escalates.
Walmart’s stock rose after announcing a partnership with Wing to expand services in Denver and Seattle.
Quebec's Parti Québécois projected to win election, pledging future independence referendum.
Yemen forces recaptured the strategic port city of Mocha from the Houthis, while Turkey and Pakistan pledged rapid military deployments to support Saudi security under the Mecca defence pact.
Oil analysts remain cautious as WTI prices hover near $89, with supply risks easing.
A 3.3 magnitude earthquake struck 118 km WSW of Hawaiian Ocean View, Hawaii.
Saudi-backed Yemeni forces claim to have secured the Red Sea waterway, with conflicting reports on seizing Mokha near Bab al-Mandab.
A gas leak is suspected to have caused an explosion that tore apart a sneaker shop in Indonesia.
A magnitude 4.4 earthquake occurred 58 km SSE of Camiña, Chile, reported by USGS.
UN Human Rights Council condemns civilian attacks in Sudan and calls for immediate ceasefire.
A magnitude 4.3 earthquake was recorded 42 km southwest of Urakawa, Japan.
USGS reported a magnitude 4.8 earthquake 86 km north of Ruteng, Indonesia.
